chapters.title: The Brass and the Deep
chapters.scene_setting: Rivet-headed iron plates weep condensation into the narrow corridor, smelling faintly of coal-oil and old salt. Through the thick glass of the deadlight, the ocean presses its immense, lightless weight against the hull like a sleeping beast. Brass dials tick in rhythm with the rhythmic, iron-lung throb of the boiler somewhere below decks. It is a world of shadows, steam, and narrow passages where the only sky is miles of black water.

chapters.title: The Long Sleep
chapters.scene_setting: The pale bioluminescence fades into a gentle, silvery twilight that stretches across an endless, silent sea floor. No cold touches the skin here, and the heavy roar of the machine has dissolved into a quiet, rhythmic pulse like a distant heartbeat. Time ceases its frantic march, leaving only the tranquil drift of floating spores and the weightless peace of the abyss. Here, the deep claims its own, wrapping them in an eternal, dreamless quiet.

chapters.title: The Salt and the Sand
chapters.scene_setting: Warm morning sunlight spills across a wide expanse of pale quartz sand, glinting off the crests of gentle, turquoise waves. A salty breeze carries the sharp scent of drying kelp and sun-warmed driftwood, rustling through the tall dune grass just beyond the reach of the tide. Gulls wheel lazily in the cloudless blue overhead, their cries faint and musical against the steady, rhythmic murmur of the surf. Here, far from the crushing darkness of the abyss, the world begins entirely anew.
